topic: Familiarization with various parts of aircraft and different arrangement of components as seen on various aircraft in station.

specific_objectives: 11.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain aircraft structure, various structural elements and their details.

practical: Identification of structural elements on station aircraft; Safety: Maintain safe distance from rotating parts; Supervision: Instructor monitors trainee proximity to engine and high-voltage zones.
intro_questions: What are the three primary functions of an aircraft structure?
Name one major structural element found on the fuselage.
Why is the arrangement of components critical for aircraft operation?
